executive.summary: Bộ test hiện có đạt, nhưng hai counterexample High mới tái hiện làm sai điều kiện current truth và tính hợp lệ của approval trong lịch sử lifecycle. V1.1 Knowledge Pilot chưa đủ điều kiện bắt đầu. Audit này không sửa implementation.
executive.critical: Không phát hiện Critical đã chứng minh trong phạm vi kiểm tra; không phải chứng nhận không còn Critical.
executive.pilot: NOT READY. Sửa H-GOV-01/H-GOV-02, thêm regression ở public write/read boundaries, chạy lại full suite và probes; sau đó mới xem xét pilot nhỏ có human review và quyền intake riêng.
v2_blockers: Hai High findings va cac regression phai duoc giai quyet truoc khi mo rong authority hoac retrieval.
Xac dinh trusted caller/approval identity va permissions cua host tools truoc khi tuyen bo agent tu tri an toan voi nguon doi khang.
Thu nghiem approval/citation relevance va lifecycle tren pilot thuc te duoc phep; giai quyet source VERIFIED self-assertion.
Natural VI unseen/paraphrase gold va recall/abstention goals can human agreement; khong coi curated aliases la semantic retrieval.
Do p95, concurrency, representative IO/revision graphs va real admission cost truoc khi chon full-text/QMD/embeddings/database/background jobs.
Process interruption/Windows link aliases/power-loss recovery can evidence trong moi truong cho phep; khong xoa recovery history de lam dep ket qua.
fix_order: Khac phuc H-GOV-01: dependency eligibility cua ADR, bo sung future/overdue/historical regression.
Khac phuc H-GOV-02: required approval validation o lifecycle transaction va history reader/Lint.
Bo sung VI/encoded attack cases, source verification semantics va alignment cua unknown metadata notes.
Lam ro runtime revision trong reports; chay lai 174 tests, 60-query gold va cac audit probes. Khong thay gold de cho test dat.
Chi sau khi blocker het, xin quyen intake pilot 25-100 trang va thong nhat latency budget; khong bat dau V2.

findings.title: ADR chưa đủ điều kiện vẫn hợp thức hóa current truth
findings.expected: Trang tong hop chi du dieu kien current truth khi ADR ho tro cung du dieu kien ve hieu luc, freshness va temporal.
findings.observed: Ba ADR hop le: future-effective, overdue va temporal=historical. Query tren trang wiki dan ADR deu FOUND, usable_as_current_truth=true. Strict Lint: 0 errors.
findings.impact: Co the tra cau hinh chua co hieu luc, can review hoac chi thuoc lich su nhu trang thai hien tai cua project.
findings.cause: decision_citations kiem approved/scope/access nhung bo qua eligibility cua ADR; current gate chi xem metadata cua trang cha.
findings.fix: Truyen eligibility/freshness/history cua ADR vao evidence va current gate, fail closed neu dependency khong du dieu kien. Them ca 3 truong hop vao suite.

findings.title: Lifecycle writer chấp nhận approval giải quyết tranh chấp không tồn tại
findings.expected: disputed -> unverified phai kiem tra documented human validation o moi public write entry point.
findings.observed: transition() tra FileNotFoundError cho approval thieu; cung event duoc transact(operation=lifecycle, authorized=True) COMMITTED. read_page va strict Lint chap nhan; approval file khong ton tai.
findings.impact: Lich su lifecycle co the tuyen bo da co phe duyet giai quyet tranh chap ma khong co record. Trang van unverified; probe KHONG chung minh tu promote len verified hoac current truth.
findings.cause: Read-time chi kiem approval string truthy cho resolution; validate_lifecycle_update chi kiem append event/content hash; nghia vu kiem approval nam o helper va co the bi bo qua.
findings.fix: Dung chung validator cho approval bat buoc o read/write boundaries; kiem resolution event, target/hash/date/evidence va conflict resolution; them direct transaction + Lint regression.

findings.title: Source VERIFIED là assertion tự khai báo, chưa có validation record
findings.observed: register_source authorized=True + VERIFIED + arbitrary note => REGISTERED; citation.verification_status=VERIFIED; strict source audit khong loi; khong co validation record.
findings.impact: Nhan source co the gay nham lan voi ket qua da kiem chung. Wiki trong probe van draft, current=false: khong phai lifecycle bypass.
findings.fix: Doi nhan thanh declared trust/assertion hoac yeu cau evidence va authorized approval binding cho source VERIFIED.

findings.title: Detector bỏ sót injection tiếng Việt và HTML entity
findings.observed: Hai detector probes tra []; VI actual Ingest COMMITTED va Query FOUND, instruction duoc giu trong title; content_trust=UNTRUSTED_DATA.
findings.impact: Attack corpus tieng Anh chua dai dien cho giao dien tieng Viet. KHONG chung minh command execution, secret access hay allowlist bypass.
findings.fix: Bo sung unseen VI/encoded adversarial cases, giu hard allowlist va tieu thu ket qua nhu DATA. Khong xem regex filter la sandbox.

findings.title: Chưa enforce notes giải thích metadata chưa biết
findings.observed: Author, published_date va notes cung rong van dang ky duoc. Khong co metadata bi phat minh.
findings.fix: Dong bo validator voi yeu cau explanation trong notes hoac sua contract qua review rieng.

findings.title: Baseline trong validation report được hardcode
findings.observed: Run moi tai HEAD 80d9d67 van ghi discovery_baseline=6097642 trong workflow report; scalability wrapper hardcode 55e6e1f. Ket qua test moi la that; nhan revision khong mo ta code dang chay.
findings.fix: Ghi runtime HEAD/dirty state va hashes; tach historical phase origin khoi tested revision. Final audit nay ghi HEAD va current hashes rieng.

findings.title: Onboarding chưa chỉ rõ admission API tại bước đầu
findings.observed: README first-source steps neu raw + append manifest nhung khong neu ledger/API ngay tai buoc do; prompt/Phase1 guide moi bo sung. Day la ambiguity doc review, chua chay mot user onboarding session.
findings.fix: Rut gon mot con duong create_raw_snapshot -> register_source -> strict Lint -> reviewed Ingest; giu original raw/metadata bat bien.

Runtime revision/dirty-state report provenance instead of hardcoded baseline labels.
Windows alias regression in a permitted environment; actual process interruption and rollback failure during recovery.
